user.title: 3D Floorplan (Container)
user.description: The address of the floorplan3d container, as Home Assistant reaches it — usually its IP address and port, for example http://192.168.1.10:8100. The plan is then served at /floorplan/ on Home Assistant's own address.

reconfigure.title: 3D Floorplan (Container)
reconfigure.description: The address of the floorplan3d container, as Home Assistant reaches it.

error.cannot_connect: Nothing answers at this address. Is the container running, and is the address the one Home Assistant can reach?
error.cannot_start_login: The container does not offer the Home Assistant login. The container version needs HA_URL and HA_TOKEN (not SUPERVISOR_TOKEN).
error.login_incomplete: The container answered, but not the way this integration expects. Is it this program (floorplan3d)?
error.invalid_address: That is not an http:// or https:// address.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one floor plan can be served at /floorplan/.
abort.entry_not_found: The integration entry no longer exists.
